text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The horizontal axis is here, and factoring in the crane's spread...
Just a little more... just move it a tiny bit—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh...? The crane arm isn't moving...

text_block_list.name: Arcade Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
This machine has been acting up lately...

text_block_list.name: Arcade Clerk
text_block_list.text: I can't do anything more than this, so I'll be issuing you a refund.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I really wanted to try out
my newly devised "New Diamond Drop"...
